description: Department of Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index for the Month of June 2021 was 145.7 (One Hundred and Forty Five Point Seven)
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for June 2021, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content is purely statistical information about economic indicators, which falls under general administrative matters not covered by Types 1-9.
